name: Network Netoraru Kare Machi Kanojo
original_name: ネトワクネトラル カレマチカノジョ
source:
The protagonist had a dream where he met his girlfriend. He woke up only to find a goddess of love besides him. The goddess gave him a database of girls that he could capture by raising flags called the "Onago" database.

This game features customization (separate from main-game) where players can create their own heroine. There are large numbers of traits that can be selected, including traits similar to other anime characters. Players can view and use their customization data by opening up the Onago Database. Said heroine can be used by other players through online mode.

[translated/edited from [url=http://www.kaorinusantara.web.id/forum/showthread.php?t=19253] KAORI Nusantara[/url]]
translation:
主人公做了一个梦，在梦中遇见了自己的女朋友。醒来后，他发现身边只有一位恋爱女神。女神给了他一个名为“Onago”的少女数据库，他可以通过触发旗标来攻略其中的女孩。

本作拥有自定义功能（与主线游戏分离），玩家可以创造属于自己的女主角。可供选择的特质种类繁多，其中还包括与其他动漫角色相似的特质。玩家可以通过打开Onago数据库来查看和使用自定义数据。创造的女主角还可以通过在线模式供其他玩家使用。

[译/编辑自[url=http://www.kaorinusantara.web.id/forum/showthread.php?t=19253]KAORI Nusantara[/url]]
